title: feat(ui): the console's pages set text in two sizes, 14 and 12, and two weights, 400 and 500
body:
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuAYvjHzALCM1EMkMFJVSe7r)_ repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUUrNKCZdu79ooP61V Fixes #36047 Slice 2 of 2. Slice 1 (#36093, merged `3ae62acd`) set the theme tokens and shared controls: the 8px control corner, the white content area and the badge weight. This slice sweeps the per-site text sizes and weights on the console's pages. Clause-②: no Metadata-protocol: none ## 维护者速读 - 控制台运行时页面只剩两种字号：正文 14（列表单元格、字段值、输入框、菜单项、工具栏按钮、单元格编辑框），次要信息 12（字段标签、表头、计数、时间、提示、小块里的字）。页面里不再有 13；原来的 10、11 和 11.5、12.5 这些零碎字号也收到 12 或 14。 - 字重只剩 400 和 500：记录名称、页签、按钮、分区标题、表头是 500，正文 400。600/700 只留在 18 号以上的页面和弹框大标题上。下拉菜单的分组标题也从 600 改成 500。 - 记录页的页签选中和未选中现在都是 14。 - 没设宽度的列表列按内容自动变宽，14 号字下会宽约 8%；视图里写死宽度或用户拖过的列宽度不变，每列少显示约 8% 的字，悬停可看全文。客户列表 1440 宽一屏可见列数前后都是 5（5 列全部放得下）。 - 单选/多选的彩色标签保持全圆（标签形状未改）。 - 不改的：Studio 和元数据管理内部、设置页、开发者工具、手机专用布局（另有 #35880 专题）、头像里的缩写字母、作者写的 markdown 和 SDUI 标题、文档阅读页的正文字号。 ## What changes **The mapping** (run as a script, re-run after every merge of `main`; conflicts are resolved by taking `main` and re-running it, never by hand): | Before | After | Where | |---|---|---| | `text-[13px]` | `text-sm` (14) | body text, cells, field values, inputs, menu items, toolbar and bar buttons, condition chips, the in-cell editor (`EDITOR_DENSITY_CLASS` and the cell input layer in `@object-ui/components`) | | `text-[13px]` | `text-xs` (12) | the same class run carries `text-muted-foreground`, `uppercase`, `tabular-nums` or `tracking-wide`, or it is a column header: labels, headers, counts, times, empty-state hints | | `text-[12.5px]`, `text-[15px]` | `text-sm` (14) | record-page panel heads and rows, the comment composer, home section headings | | `text-[9px]` … `text-[11.5px]` | `text-xs` (12) | captions, counts, kbd hints, chip text, badges | | `font-semibold`, `font-bold` | `font-medium` (500) | everything except a class run that also sets `text-lg` or larger | Kept on purpose, each named in the script's exception list: avatar initials and the one-letter record-link mark (glyphs sized to their circle), phone-only branches (`isMobile` rows, `Phone*` files, the phone search keyword, the phone sidebar app name), authored content typography (markdown `strong` and headings, SDUI `h1`–`h6` presets), and the docs reader's prose size. Directories not swept: `views/studio-design`, `views/metadata-admin`, the settings pages, `pages/developer`, `views/item-tools`, the draft-preview bar, and dev-only harnesses. The home page's first-run checklist lives under `pages/settings` but is drawn on the console home, so it is swept. **Shared parts beyond the class sweep** - `DropdownMenuLabel` (`@object-ui/components`, Shadcn-synced) is `font-medium` instead of `font-semibold`, through a declared local patch `dropdown-menu-label-medium-weight` in `ui/scripts/shadcn-local-patches.mjs`, anchored on the already vendored `dropdown-menu.registry.txt`. `shadcn-components.json` names it. `ContextMenuLabel`, `MenubarLabel` and `SelectLabel` are not patched: no console runtime page renders them. - The list view bar: the object name is 14 (it was 13), the `/` separator after it is 14 (it inherited 16). **Counts**, on the branch merged with `main` (`a2dc8589`): 386 sizes and weights changed in 123 source files; 110 kept by the rules above (76 titles 18px and larger, 25 named exceptions, 9 avatar initials). A dry re-run of the script on the merged branch changes nothing. ## Why #36047 items 1 and 2 (maintainer-approved Attio comparison): two text sizes, 14 and 12, and two weights, 400 and 500, with page titles excepted. The card's own measurement found 12, 13 and 14 and 400, 500 and 600 on one page. ## Verification Measured in a real browser (CRM example, console dev server against it), 1440 and 375, light and dark, before and after: list (account), record page (opportunity), kanban (opportunity pipeline), create dialog, console home. Font size and weight of every visible text node outside the sidebar. | page, 1440 light | sizes before | sizes after | weights before | weights after | |---|---|---|---|---| | list | 10, 12, 13, 14, 16 | 12, 14, 16¹ | 400, 500, 600 | 400, 500 | | record | 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 16 | 12, 14, 16² | 400, 500, 600 | 400, 500 | | kanban | 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 16 | 10³, 12, 14, 16¹ | 400, 500, 600 | 400, 500 | | create dialog | 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 16 | 12, 14, 16⁴ | 400, 500, 600 | 400, 500, 600⁴ | | home | 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 24 | 12, 14, 16, 24⁵ | 400, 500, 600 | 400, 500, 600⁵ | ¹ the visually hidden skip link. ² the record name (16/500). ³ avatar initials. ⁴ the dialog title (16/600, #35980). ⁵ the greeting (24/600) and the checklist title (16/500). Dark is identical. At 375 the phone faces are unchanged by design (15px record rows, the 17px phone title). Visible columns on the account list at 1440: 5 before, 5 after (all five fit). Record tabs: selected and unselected are both 14px. Tests, local, on the branch merged with `main` (`146b6f9b`): the full vitest suites of `components`, `fields`, `plugin-grid`, `plugin-list`, `plugin-detail`, `plugin-kanban`, `plugin-form`, `app-shell` and `console`, plus `ui/scripts/__tests__`, all pass; eslint on every changed file: 0 errors. After the second merge with `main` (`a2dc8589`, which brought the comment panel and the list draft buttons): the 175 test files that import a re-mapped file pass (2,608 tests) and eslint on every changed file has 0 errors. Pins moved with the values: ten unit-test assertions and three e2e specs (`list-frame-geometry-35548`, `narrow-drawer-time-34614`, `record-tabs-rail-35595`; 20 passed locally against a production build). ## The mapping script Not committed: it is a one-off for this sweep and the follow-up re-run. All four files, as run:
s2map.mjs: the mapping: `node s2map.mjs [--apply] [--table=out.tsv]` ```js #!/usr/bin/env node // #36047 slice 2 mapping script: text sizes -> 14/12, weights 600/700 -> 500, on the console's runtime pages. // // node s2map.mjs [--apply] [--table=out.tsv] // // files.txt ui-relative paths to sweep (one per line). // overrides.tsv `pathanchortokenresult` rows: the anchor is a substring of the line // (so a row survives line moves on a main merge); result is a replacement token or // `keep`. A row whose token is `*` applies to every token on that line. // Without --apply it only prints the table (path:line, before, after, rule, excerpt). import fs from 'node:fs'; import path from 'node:path'; const [uiDir, filesTxt, overridesTsv, ...rest] = process.argv.slice(2); const apply = rest.includes('--apply'); const tableOut = (rest.find((a) => a.startsWith('--table=')) || '').slice(8); const overrides = []; if (overridesTsv && fs.existsSync(overridesTsv)) { for (const raw of fs.readFileSync(overridesTsv, 'utf8').split('\n')) { if (raw.startsWith('#') || !raw.trim()) continue; const [file, anchor, token, result] = raw.split('\t'); overrides.push({ file, anchor, token, result, id: overrides.length }); } } const usedOverrides = new Set(); // A Tailwind token with optional variant prefixes (md:, [&_input]:, before:, !). const TOKEN = /(? o.file === rel && lineText.includes(o.anchor) && (o.token === '*' || o.token === body || o.token === `${prefix}${bang}${body}`)); if (hit) { usedOverrides.add(hit.id); return hit.result === 'keep' ? { after: null, rule: 'override:keep' } : { after: hit.result, rule: 'override' }; } // Initials inside an avatar are a glyph sized to its circle, not text. if (/AvatarFallback/.test(lineText)) return { after: null, rule: 'avatar:keep' }; if (body.startsWith('font-')) { if (BIG.test(lineText)) return { after: null, rule: 'big-title:keep' }; return { after: 'font-medium', rule: 'weight' }; } const n = Number(px); if (n === 13) { return SECONDARY.test(lineText) ? { after: 'text-xs', rule: '13→12 secondary' } : { after: 'text-sm', rule: '13→14 body' }; } if (n === 12.5) return { after: 'text-sm', rule: '12.5→14' }; if (n < 13) return { after: 'text-xs', rule: 'small→12' }; if (n === 15) return { after: 'text-sm', rule: '15→14' }; return { after: null, rule: 'big:keep' }; } const files = fs.readFileSync(filesTxt, 'utf8').split('\n').map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean); const rows = []; let changedFiles = 0; for (const rel of files) { const abs = path.join(uiDir, rel); if (!fs.existsSync(abs)) { rows.push([`${rel}:-`, '-', '-', 'missing', '']); continue; } const src = fs.readFileSync(abs, 'utf8'); const lines = src.split('\n'); let touched = false; for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) { const text = lines[i]; if (!TOKEN.test(text)) continue; TOKEN.lastIndex = 0; lines[i] = text.replace(TOKEN, (m, prefix, bang, body, px) => { const { after, rule } = decide(rel, i + 1, text, prefix, bang, body, px); rows.push([`${rel}:${i + 1}`, m, after ? `${prefix}${bang}${after}` : '(keep)', rule, text.trim().slice(0, 160)]); if (!after) return m; touched = true; return `${prefix}${bang}${after}`; }); } if (touched) { changedFiles++; // A `text-sm md:text-sm` pair left by the swap collapses to one token. let out = lines.join('\n').replace(/\b(text-(?:xs|sm)) md:\1\b/g, '$1'); if (apply) fs.writeFileSync(abs, out); } } const tsv = rows.map((r) => r.join('\t')).join('\n') + '\n'; if (tableOut) fs.writeFileSync(tableOut, tsv); else process.stdout.write(tsv); const unused = overrides.filter((o) => !usedOverrides.has(o.id)).map((o) => `${o.file} ${o.anchor.slice(0, 40)}`); const counts = rows.reduce((a, r) => ((a[r[3]] = (a[r[3]] || 0) + 1), a), {}); console.error(JSON.stringify({ sites: rows.length, changedFiles, apply, counts, unusedOverrides: unused }, null, 1)); ```
s2-files.sh: the file list: `s2-files.sh cat.sh > files.txt` ```bash #!/bin/bash # Regenerate the slice 2 sweep file list from the current tree. usage: s2-files.sh > files.txt cd "$1" SCOPE="packages/app-shell/src packages/plugin-grid/src packages/plugin-list/src packages/plugin-detail/src packages/plugin-kanban/src packages/plugin-form/src packages/fields/src packages/components/src/renderers packages/components/src/custom packages/components/src/share packages/components/src/notifications apps/console/src" git ls-files $SCOPE | grep -E '\.(tsx?|css)$' | grep -vE '(\.test\.|\.spec\.|__tests__|\.stories\.|/test/|/e2e/)' | grep -vE 'views/(studio-design|metadata-admin)/' \ | xargs grep -lE 'text-\[(9|10|10\.5|11|11\.5|12\.5|13|15|17)px\]|font-(semibold|bold|extrabold)\b' \ | while read f; do [ "$("$2" "$f")" = sweep ] && echo "$f"; done ```
cat.sh: which paths are swept ```bash #!/bin/bash # classify a ui-relative path f="$1" case "$f" in apps/console/src/pages/settings/FirstRunChecklist.tsx) echo sweep;; # drawn on the console home apps/console/src/dev/*|apps/console/src/*-preview.tsx|apps/console/src/preview-gallery.tsx|apps/console/src/dev-*) echo devonly;; */Phone*|*/Mobile*|*/phone/*|*/mobile/*) echo phone;; apps/console/src/pages/settings/*|*/console/organizations/*|*/console/notification-settings/*|*/views/setup/*|*/console/cloud-connection/*|apps/console/src/pages/system/ProfilePage.tsx) echo settings;; apps/console/src/pages/developer/*|*/views/item-tools/*|*/views/MetadataInspector.tsx|*/preview/*) echo devtools;; *) echo sweep;; esac ```
